reports.title: UGI Reports Fiscal 2026 Results; Issues Fiscal 2027 Guidance

guidance.heading: 2027 OUTLOOK
section: UGI provides an adjusted EPS guidance range of $2.90 - $3.202 per diluted share for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027. This guidance range assumes normal weather and the current tax regime.

desk.headline: Plans to spin off its LPG business; full-year adjusted EPS $3.00 beat its own range; first fiscal 2027 guide of $2.90–3.20

numbers.eps_basis: diluted GAAP (quarterly adjusted EPS not disclosed)

results: Seasonally weak September quarter: revenue fell 3% to $1.16bn (below the single analyst estimate of $1.41bn) and GAAP EPS was $0.04 vs a $0.06 loss.
Full year adjusted EPS was $3.00, down from $3.32 on higher interest and tax, but above the range set in May (about $0.10 came from tax benefits).
Gas utilities drove growth: Utilities EBIT up 13% to $456m on higher Pennsylvania rates and colder weather.
AmeriGas propane EBIT fell 17% to $137m as retail gallons dropped 5%; International volumes fell 10% after selling businesses in seven countries.
About $900m invested in the year; liquidity of $1.8bn and net leverage of 3.8x. Electric utility sale for about $470m is pending.

guidance.summary: First range for fiscal 2027: adjusted EPS of $2.90–3.20, assuming normal weather and the current structure, with capex of $1.0–1.2bn and net leverage at or below 3.75x.

points: The board approved a plan to split off Global LPG (AmeriGas plus UGI International) as a separate listed company, aimed at the second half of 2027 and meant to be tax-free.
The remaining gas utility and midstream company targets 8–10% yearly rate-base growth, 6–8% EPS growth and over $5bn of investment in FY27–31.
Global LPG targets $250–300m of near-term free cash flow, with dividends and buybacks; UGI may keep up to 19.9% at first.
AmeriGas had its lowest customer losses in five years and won new data-centre construction and cylinder-exchange accounts.
Rate cases settled after year-end: $65m in two steps for UGI Utilities and $17m at Mountaineer Gas in West Virginia.
call.source: Earnings presentation (Exhibit 99.2) and MarketBeat via Yahoo Finance, 19 Nov 2026

watch: Progress on the Global LPG separation: board sign-off, Form 10 filing and debt consents.
Winter weather and AmeriGas volumes in the December and March quarters.
Closing of the electric utility sale and the Auburn pipeline conversion in the second half of FY27.
